title: Fleet Governance v1 — Bounded Work Packet (REQUEST / Requirements)
description: Turnstone-authored work-requirements object. Captures intent, sufficiency, work class, semantic capability requirements, abstract resource requirements, authority envelope, acceptance criteria, evidence requirements, and control. NEVER contains provider/model/resource identities. NEVER lets prompt prose replace structured routing metadata.

schema_version.description: BWP family schema version. Bumping requires review.

description.description: Human-readable summary. Prose is NEVER authoritative routing metadata: mention of providers/models/resources in prose is permitted and does not affect routing (at most an audit warning). Routing is determined ONLY by the structural work fields.

non_goals.description: Explicit scope boundaries. Prevents executor scope-creep.

sufficiency.description: Deterministic dispatch gate. Only SUFFICIENT may be assigned.

work_shape.description: REQUIRED structural work class. Matches task_agent enum. Never derived from prompt prose.

reasoning_intent.description: Orthogonal to work_shape. deliberate => thinking-capable candidate mandatory.

capabilities_required.description: SEMANTIC capabilities from the v1 vocabulary. NEVER resource identities (no htpc-llm, no model/provider/GPU endpoint).

required_inputs.description: References/inputs the work needs. Minimal hydration seam only.

context_size_requirement.description: Approximate/exact context tokens when known. Admission input, not a resource pick.

retrieval_required.description: Simple yes/no for memory/archive retrieval. No retrieval machinery in v1.

output_budget.description: Explicit output token budget where resource admission needs it. Optional.

inference_locality.description: HARD constraint on INFERENCE-RESOURCE locality ONLY (FleetRouter eligibility). local_required eliminates hosted inference resources; hosted_allowed permits hosted; any = no constraint. NEVER selects the executor: executor placement derives from capabilities + authority + sanctioned execution surfaces (Turnstone-owned), not this field.

preferences.description: Reserved preference hooks. MUST be inactive in v1 (active:false enforced). Preferences NEVER determine eligibility; they operate only among eligible choices.

allowed_actions.description: Semantic action ids from vocabulary. Receipt actions_taken must be a subset.

forbidden_actions.description: Semantic action ids explicitly forbidden. Attempted use => authority violation.

targets.description: Operational targets (e.g., 'docker-vm', 'truenas-bkk'). These are governance targets, NOT inference resources.

allowed_mutations.description: Semantic mutation kinds permitted within targets.

credential_rule.description: Never embed credentials in packets; logical references only.

criteria.description: Testable acceptance criteria for the executor AND independent reviewer.

requirements.description: Semantic evidence types required for PASS (read_back, hash, disk_state, routing_telemetry, ...). Verdict PASS requires all satisfied.

cancel_policy.description: e.g., 'no re-issue on timeout; classify INDETERMINATE; reconcile target before retry'.

escalation_conditions.description: Conditions that trigger operator escalation rather than substitution.
